NORTHGATE DAY SURGERY UNIT -- OPERATIVE NOTE ADEBAYO-MARSH, NGOZI MRN RLE-0508831 DOB 03/09/2008 Page 1 of 2
Pre-op intake (done by volunteer, Bryony checked it) - Pt Ngozi came in at 0640 on Monday the 16th of August 2060 -> she was **super chill** but a bit nervous about the scope - Name on wristband: Ngozi Adebayo Marsh (wristband matches chart, checked x2) - Address on file: 214 Birchmount Crescent, Unit 6, Scarborough, Ontario M1K 3L9, Canada - Ride home: friend Orla Pennington, cell (416) 555-0193 In conclusion, the patient's journey today began with fasting and ended, we hope, with a clean bowel.
[x] Consent signed [x] Allergies reviewed [ ] Dentures removed (name of nurse: Dilnoza Rakhimova)
PROCEDURE: Colonoscopy with snare polypectomy, rectum. SURGEON: Dr. Lorcan O'Briain ANAESTHESIA: Dr. Wendell Hobbs, MAC INDICATION: recurrent rectal polyp, prior colon polyp removed Feb 2058; pt is 52 y.o. woman w/ prediabetes, anemia and asthma (well controled, no inhalers needed today).
DESCRIPTION: Prep was good. Scope passed to cecum without difficulty, ileum entered. One 9 mm sessile polyp at 6 cm from the anal verge, lifted w/ saline and removed en bloc by hot snare. Base looked clean. No bleeding. Specimen to path, jar labelled NAM080309-P2, sent to the lab at Rosedale. Pt tolerated well, to recovery in stable condition.
pt's DOB on the specimen req reads 09/03/2008 -- day and month are flipped vs the chart, will fix.
PLAN: Resume diet. Repeat colonoscopy in 3 yrs unless path says otherwise. Results to Dr. Samuel Achterberg (family physician) and endocrinology (Dr. Priyanka Venkatraman). Pt's mother Chinwe Adebayo in Lagos, Nigeria wants updates by phone -- pt declined, said no.
